summary: ssh-agent socket relocation after vault rewrap causes ephemeral runner SSH auth failures
summary_short: Ephemeral runners fail to authenticate via SSH after Vault transit rewrap moved agent socket path
description:
Issue summary:
A Vault transit rewrap that coincided with a CI image refresh resulted in SSH agent socket files being created under a different path inside ephemeral runner containers. Runner init and job entrypoints assume a predictable SSH_AUTH_SOCK path; when the socket was created under /run/user/<uid>/ssh-XXXX the job processes could not locate the agent and all git-over-ssh operations failed.

Impact:
- ~120 nightly release pipeline runs in us-east failed between 2026-03-12 02:40 and 2026-03-12 03:25 UTC.
- Failures manifested as immediate git fetch/clone authorization errors, blocking canary artifact promotion and delaying three release jobs.

Environment:
- Prod CI (ephemeral runner fleet) in us-east region
- Runner base image: rdx/ci-runner:2026-03-10
- Vault: transit rewrap performed 2026-03-12 02:30 UTC

Expected behavior:
- Ephemeral runner init should locate active ssh-agent socket or start an agent and export SSH_AUTH_SOCK so job steps that perform SSH can authenticate.

Observed behavior:
- Job logs show errors: 'Could not open a connection to your authentication agent.' and 'ssh: connect to socket /tmp/ssh-XXXXX: No such file or directory'.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Perform Vault transit rewrap on the service account used by runner bootstrap (simulated in staging).
2) Trigger ephemeral runner provisioning with current rdx/ci-runner image and bootstrap scripts that source ~/.bashrc for SSH setup.
3) In the runner container run: git ls-remote git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra.git and observe ssh auth failure if SSH_AUTH_SOCK points to non-existent socket.
4) Inspect /proc/<pid>/environ for the job shell to confirm SSH_AUTH_SOCK and check socket location on filesystem.
logs:
2026-03-12T02:42:19Z job-step[git-clone]: fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
Please make sure you have the correct access rights and the repository exists.
ssh: connect to socket /tmp/ssh-Gk2f9K/socket: No such file or directory
2026-03-12T02:42:20Z kubelet[warn]: bind mount of host socket to container failed: path changed post-rotation
investigation_notes: - Correlated Vault transit rewrap window with start of failures. Rewrap rotated secrets used by cloud-init that influence systemd user session behavior; side-effect: ssh-agent created by systemd user spawned under /run/user/<uid> instead of historical /tmp prefix.

- Runner image update on 2026-03-10 introduced a change in bootstrap ordering: ssh-agent is now started by 'systemd --user' early in the boot, while the old entrypoint created a socket in /tmp and exported SSH_AUTH_SOCK before job steps inherit env vars.

- Ephemeral runner bootstrap relies on a deterministic SSH_AUTH_SOCK path derived from a tmp prefix; when systemd user created the agent in a different namespace, the bind-mount step in the runner pod creation failed because it attempted to reference the old /tmp path on the host where no socket existed.
- Reproduced in staging by forcing ssh-agent to use /run/user path; confirmed that without a fallback we see immediate git-over-ssh failures in job container.
short_term_workaround: 1) Patch runner-init to probe common agent locations (/tmp/ssh-*, /run/user/*/ssh-*) and, if found, export the discovered path into job environment before executing steps.
2) For existing pods, restart the ephemeral runner pods to pick up patched init; applied to canary pool (5% of runners) to validate.
3) For particularly urgent releases, use HTTPS git remotes as a temporary workaround (not ideal for deploy keys).
resolution_notes:
Hotfix: Commit rdx/ci-runner@patch-2026-03-13 modifies entrypoint to perform a socket discovery routine and fall back to starting a local ssh-agent if no socket is found. Deployed a canary rollout to 5% of ephemeral runners at 2026-03-13 09:10 UTC. Observed success: subsequent nightly jobs in canary used discovered /run/user sockets or started their own agent and completed git operations. Full rollout to prod runners completed 2026-03-14 03:30 UTC.

Follow-ups scheduled: update runbook for Vault rewrap procedures to include runner socket invariants, add a CI test that simulates agent socket relocation, and coordinate with infra team to avoid simultaneous image & Vault rewraps during midnight deploy window.
postmortem_actions: - ACTION-1: Add socket-discovery integration tests to runner image CI (owner: CI Eng, due: 2026-03-20)
- ACTION-2: Update Vault rotation runbook to notify CI/Runner teams and pause image rollouts if socket namespace behavior changes (owner: Security/Infra, due: 2026-03-18)
- ACTION-3: Instrument agent socket creation in runner metrics and alert if a socket path is created outside accepted prefixes (owner: Observability, due: 2026-03-25)
- ACTION-4: Add a canary gating step to prevent Vault transit rewraps and runner image rollouts from overlapping (owner: Release Eng, due: 2026-03-22)
